jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionAs Senior Global Medical Manager Immuno-Oncology, you will contribute scientific and medical leadership to the global medical strategy for an early oncology brand. Reporting to the Brand Head Immuno-Oncology, you will be accountable for defined medical deliverables that prepare the asset and healthcare ecosystem for future clinical adoption and patient access. Working in a global matrix, including close collaboration with the Pipeline Medical Affairs Lead, you will translate scientific evidence, external insights and unmet needs into focused medical strategies, evidence-generation plans and measurable outcomes that help close relevant care gaps.Tasks & responsibilities- Contribute to the development and continuous refinement of the global medical strategy, translating strategic priorities, unmet needs and care gaps into clearly defined medical deliverables and outcome measures.- Take end-to-end accountability for the strategic direction, quality and timely delivery of major medical deliverables. These include Medical Affairs-led evidence generation, scientific communication and publications, external expert engagement, patient-journey and care-gap analysis, and medical launch preparation.- Shape and drive Medical Affairs-led evidence generation within the Integrated Evidence Plan, including investigator-initiated studies, Phase IIIb/IV studies, real-world evidence and other fit-for-purpose approaches that address decision-relevant evidence gaps and support future clinical practice.- Lead medical launch preparation for assigned areas by defining the scientific narrative, building organizational and country readiness, anticipating evidence and education needs, and supporting the conditions required for appropriate clinical adoption and patient access.- Build trusted scientific relationships with international experts, societies, research networks and other stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem, translating external insights into strategic recommendations, evidence priorities and medical action.- Provide medical leadership across global, regional and cross-functional teams, working closely with the Pipeline Medical Affairs Lead and partners in Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Market Access, Commercial and country Medical Affairs to ensure strategic alignment and high-quality execution.Requirements- Advanced degree in medicine or life sciences (MD, PhD, PharmD or equivalent) and long-term experience in Medical Affairs within the pharmaceutical industry with global and regional/ local responsibility.- Mandatory, substantial experience in immuno-oncology and non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), supported by an in-depth understanding of the scientific and clinical landscape, evolving treatment paradigms, unmet needs and barriers across the patient journey. Experience in colorectal cancer (CRC), pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) and/or breast cancer is highly desirable.- Proven experience contributing to global medical strategy and leading complex medical workstreams for oncology assets, including medical launch preparation or indication expansion.- Demonstrated track record in shaping and delivering Medical Affairs-led evidence generation, including the identification and prioritization of evidence gaps, development of study concepts, oversight of study delivery and translation of results into decision-relevant medical insights.- Established collaboration with international oncology experts, scientific societies, research networks and other stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem, with the ability to convert external perspectives into strategic recommendations and action.- Strong matrix leadership, strategic judgment and execution discipline, with the ability to lead through influence, align diverse stakeholders and deliver high-quality outcomes in a complex global environment. Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills and full professional proficiency in English.As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.What We OfferWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until November 30th, 2026. jobs.occupation: Post-Doc position: AI-Driven Robotic Experimentation for Controlling Metal Degradation (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: Metal degradation can be a boon or a bane, depending on the application and on how well we can control it. A corroding car component is a safety risk. A biodegradable metal implant that dissolves at exactly the right rate spares patients a second surgery. An aqueous battery lives or dies depending on what happens at its electrodes.At the Department of Electrochemistry and Big Data we unravel degradation pathways of light metals used in structural applications, medical devices and aqueous batteries. For these applications, degradation can be controlled using tailored electrolyte additives. The chemical space of possible additives is virtually infinite, so we do not test one-by-one. We run a robotic, high-throughput testing platform coupled with machine learning and AI agents that help to decide which experiment to run next. Join us to build the self-driving laboratory of corrosion science.We are offering a 2‑year Post-Doctoral position, as soon as possible, in the quickly developing field of robotic experimentation in materials science. The position is full-time (39 h/week) and will be located in Hereon's main campus, in Geesthacht (near Hamburg).We value diversity and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We particularly encourage qualified women to apply.Your tasks- Run and extend automated experimental workflows on our robotic platform to test how light alloys respond to electrolytes of increasing complexity- Discover high-performing organic and inorganic compounds that control degradation for structural and biomedical applications- Work side by side with computational scientists to build structure-property models, and use AI agents to accelerate screening- Uncover the mechanisms behind effective degradation control, and turn them into design rules for pre-selecting promising compounds- Publish your results in leading journals, present at international conferences, write project reports and contribute to open, FAIR datasetsYour profile- A completed master's and PhD degree in chemistry, electrochemistry, materials science, computational materials science or a related field- Solid experimental skills in chemical laboratories and confidence in quantitative data analysis using appropriate software- Experience with corrosion, electrochemical methods or light alloys (Mg, Al, Zn)- Experience with lab automation, electronic lab notebooks, FAIR data, databases or machine learning- Curiosity about automation and AI, and motivation to work at the interface of experiment and computation- Very good English, knowledge of the German language is preferred but not mandatory, we support language learningContent-related enquiries regarding this position can be directed to Sviatlana.Lamaka(at)hereon.de.Our offer- Access to state-of-the-art (robotic) labs, unique scientific and technical infrastructure- Access to a large international research and industrial network.- Funding for conferences, summer schools and courses needed or research stays- An exciting and varied job in a research center with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations- An International Welcome Office with guest accommodation- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between Christmas and New Year's DaySocial benefits under the collective agreement for the German public sector and remuneration up to pay grade 13 (EntgO Bund)A well-connected research campus, good networking opportunities, a subsidized Deutschlandticket (job ticket) subject to certain conditions, and charging facilities for electric vehicles- Individual opportunities for further training- An excellent technical infrastructure and modern workplace equipment- A family-friendly working environment with childcare options, e. g. a daycare center close to the workplace- Workplace health promotion programmes, e.g. an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)- Corporate Benefits- A varied canteen offering on campusSchwerbehinderte und diesen gleichgestellte behinderte Personen werden bei gleicher Qualifikation und Eignung im Rahmen der gesetzlichen Bestimmungen bevorzugt berücksichtigt.Bitte bewerben Sie sich mit Ihrem vollständigen Bewerbungsprofil (Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, sonstige Referenzen) über unsere Karriereseite.
